messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, including its lighting effects on the person. Change only the environment and its lighting. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands still at first, then steps back and performs a few casual dance moves, including a hand gesture near his face and a slight body sway, before returning to a standing pose.","camera":"The camera starts in a medium shot and slowly pulls back to a full-body view, keeping the subject centered.","clothing":"He wears a white sleeveless tank top with a palm-tree graphic and “Los Angeles” text, matching white shorts with white trim, and white sneakers.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short, closely cropped dark hair.","identity":"A young Black man with a slim build and short dark hair stands facing the camera.","scene":"The setting is a wet, reflective outdoor plaza at night, with a large glass building behind him displaying a glowing green circular neon sign and pink and blue ambient lighting."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a daytime European-style street with a Union Jack flag to a wet reflective plaza at night in front of a glass building with a large green circular neon sign and pink/blue ambient lighting. The person now has strong pink/red and blue lighting on his skin and clothing, matching the new environment. His identity, clothing, dance-like actions, and centered pull-back camera framing remain broadly consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original street scene with the reference environment, including its lighting effects on the person, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, expression, action, and camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the subtle facial expression was preserved exactly is difficult to judge from the frames.
unexpected_changes: The person's skin and clothing are heavily tinted by the new scene lighting, making the white shorts appear pink/red in many frames.
